jobs.description:
The Director of Engineering must leverage their experience, knowledge, and expertise to provide leadership and vision to a team of design engineers and technicians to ensure Janicki has a flexible and diverse team capable of supporting a wide range of design and engineering projects. The Director of Engineering develops individuals, teams, and company procedures to support the vision and demands of continuous improvement and growth.

The position requires execution of the following essential job functions:

  • Provides leadership and vision to the Design and Engineering team to inspire the continuous improvement of JI products, processes, individuals, and teams
  • Ensures the establishment, monitoring, and reporting of key metrics that support the vision for continuous improvement and growth
  • Maintains a focus on employee communication, mentorship, growth, and morale
  • Ensures the establishment and adherence to design process and workflow that support AS9100 requirements
  • Provides management and oversight to the Design and Engineering team in the areas of capacity planning, resources management, delegation, efficiency, and design schedule execution to support Janicki’s commitment to on-time product delivery
  • Ensures effective risk management in the areas of delegation, design workflow, and offload management
  • Ensures Design and Engineering team engages in effective stakeholder communication
  • Develops and maintains relationships with a well-rounded group of offload resources capable of supporting Janicki’s wide range of design requirements
  • Provides management support to lead designers for underperforming projects and offload resources
  • Delegates project assignments to Design manager, lead design engineers and other staff
  • Promotes effective communication between the design and engineering team and their customers
  • Ensures the Design and Engineering team maintains a commitment and focus on excellent customer service both internally and externally
  • Ensures there is proper oversight and review of designs and engineering plans
  • Behavior: The incumbent must work well under pressure, meeting and completing multiple deadlines. The incumbent shall, at all times, demonstrate cooperative behavior with colleagues and supervisors.
  • Being at work on time and maintaining good attendance is a condition of employment and is an essential function of the job.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Due to our ITAR and EAR regulations, applicants must be a US Citizen or of Legal Permanent Resident Status as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b (a) (3).
  • This position requires the ability to obtain a U.S. Secret Security Clearance (U.S. Citizenship Required).  Janicki will assist with gaining this access once employed. Special Access Program or other Government Access Requirements are mandatory for this position and requires candidate agreed to enter a Continuous Evaluation program.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or a related field is required
  • 7-10+ years' experience as a Program Manager, Senior Project Engineer, Senior Design Engineer or equivalent position required
  • Must have strong communication skills through written, verbal, and graphical mediums in the English language
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CATIA, and NX CAD software is required

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION 

  • Salary range for this role is between $130,000 - $185,000, plus discretionary bonus, 401(k) matching, vacation, and health benefits. Employees can also receive additional pay for off-shifts. The range provided is Janicki’s estimate of the base compensation for this role. Actual amount offered will be based on job-related and non-discriminatory factors such as experience, location, education, training, skills, and abilities
  • By applying for this job, you are expressing interest in this position and could be considered for other career opportunities where similar skills and requirements have been identified as a match. Should this match be identified, you may be contacted for this and future openings

BENEFITS

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance with employer contribution
  • Disability insurance as well as Life/AD&D insurance
  • HSA (Health Savings Account) with employer contribution and FSA (Flexible Savings Account)
  • 401k with employer matching
  • Paid time off and paid holidays (including two floating holidays)
  • Education reimbursement program
  • Several shift options
  • Premium pay for off-shifts

Job#: 3046042

Job Description:


Sr. Electrical Design Engineer III

Location: Redmond, Washington (Onsite)

Role Overview

Our organization is seeking two Senior Electrical Engineers, one with a digital/high-speed focus and one with a power focus. These roles involve designing advanced electronic hardware for demanding applications. The positions require end-to-end ownership of hardware design, from schematic and interface definition through to lab bring-up, validation, and manufacturing readiness.

Key Responsibilities: Digital Electrical Engineer

  • Design complex multi-layer digital PCBs, including schematic capture and component selection.
  • Define and constrain high-speed digital interfaces.
  • Manage clocking, resets, boot/configuration, and general-purpose I/O for the digital subsystem.
  • Perform pre- and post-layout signal-integrity analysis.
  • Partner with layout teams on routing dense, high-pin-count devices.
  • Lead digital bring-up, including power-on, clocking, and interface validation.
  • Debug hardware in a lab environment using high-speed instrumentation.
  • Develop and execute functional and interface test plans.
  • Support hardware, firmware, and software integration.

Key Responsibilities: Power Electrical Engineer

  • Define board power architecture, including rail planning, budgeting, and sequencing.
  • Design DC-DC converters, LDOs, and load switches, performing margin and derating analysis.
  • Design and analyze the power distribution network.
  • Manage power sequencing and supervision.
  • Lead power bring-up activities in the lab.
  • Debug and characterize power supplies using analyzers, electronic loads, and oscilloscopes.
  • Develop and execute power test plans across varying voltage and temperature conditions.
  • Contribute to design-for-manufacturability and test procedures for power circuits.

Required Qualifications

Education: A bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or an equivalent field is required.

Experience:

  • Demonstrated ownership of complex digital or multi-rail board design from schematic through bring-up and validation.
  • Hands-on experience in digital or power hardware design.
  • Strong fundamentals in high-speed digital design or switching and linear regulator design.
  • Hands-on lab proficiency with high-speed test equipment and a structured debug methodology.

Technical Skills:

  • Proficiency with schematic capture and PCB design tools such as Siemens Xpedition, Cadence, or Altium.
  • Ability to interpret datasheets and technical manuals to make correct design decisions.

Other Requirements: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with processor/FPGA/SoC-based hardware design.
  • Signal-integrity or power-integrity simulation experience.
  • Experience with power delivery for FPGAs/SoCs.
  • Experience in high-reliability or harsh-environment design.
  • Knowledge of scripting for test automation (e.g., Python).
  • Experience with thermal analysis and co-design with mechanical teams.

Job Description:


System Engineer 5

Location: REDMOND, Washington (On-site)

Role Overview

A research engineering team is seeking a DevOps and Infrastructure Engineer to join their group focused on building a new micro-VM platform optimized for agentic workloads. This role involves owning the infrastructure stack that supports the team, including provisioning compute environments, maintaining benchmarking frameworks, and ensuring a robust CI/CD pipeline. The position operates at the intersection of systems research and product engineering, contributing to how cloud infrastructure runs AI workloads at scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provision and manage multi-platform cloud compute environments, automating configuration to reduce setup overhead.
  • Coordinate host access and isolation across team workloads while maintaining cloud subscriptions in a compliant and cost-efficient manner.
  • Improve the development environment and agentic engineering processes.
  • Own and extend the benchmarking harness for VM lifecycle measurements, tracking metrics such as boot latency, memory footprint, and throughput.
  • Design experiments for single-instance and concurrent-burst scenarios to surface regressions and validate improvements.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines across all project repositories, automating build, test, and validation workflows.
  • Manage binary delivery channels for kernel, VM, and agent artifacts to accelerate developer iteration loops.

Required Qualifications

Education: A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering is required.

Experience: 10+ years of relevant systems or infrastructure engineering experience is required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience as a strong open-source contributor with a notable contribution history.
  • A strong GitHub track record that demonstrates technical work.
  • Previous experience at a major technology company.

(Spokane Valley, WA) ANDRITZ Hydro Corp is looking for a Systems & Commissioning Engineer responsible for technical coordination, verification, and commissioning of hydroelectric power generation systems. Focus on automation, instrumentation, control interfaces, and auxiliary systems; support projects from design review and technical planning through site execution, start-up, and system validation; bridge engineering execution and project delivery by coordinating technical activities across engineering, suppliers, field teams, and project stakeholders; apply engineering judgment to ensure system functionality, integration, compliance, and adherence to schedule, quality, and project requirements; contribute to successful project execution, reduction of commissioning risk, and long-term operational reliability of hydroelectric facilities.


Key Duties:

•       System Technical Coordination & Integration:

Coordinate technical activities for assigned hydroelectric systems, including review of scope, technical interfaces, design intent, supplier inputs, and alignment of engineering deliverables with project requirements.

•       Commissioning, Start-Up & Functional Validation:

Perform and support commissioning, start-up, and validation of automation, instrumentation, control systems, and auxiliary systems for hydroelectric units.

•       Design Review, Technical Documentation & Deliverables:

Review technical documentation, commissioning procedures, drawings, test protocols, and design packages to support safe installation, efficient execution, and compliant system performance.

•       Technical Clarifications & Cross-Functional Support:

Provide technical clarification and coordination among engineering disciplines, project management, suppliers, field service teams, and customers to support resolution of system-related issues.

•       System Performance, Quality & Change Management:

Support management of technical deviations, non-conformances, quality issues, and corrective actions affecting assigned systems, with focus on maintaining project objectives and system performance.

•       Site Execution, Troubleshooting & Continuous Improvement:

Support on-site technical execution, troubleshooting, and lessons learned activities to improve commissioning outcomes, installation quality, and operational reliability.


Minimum Requirements:      

Education: Bachelor degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering or related field.

Experience: four (4) years of experience in hydroelectric or power generation.

Special Skills/non-quantitative Experience with:

•       Experience in automation, control systems, commissioning, start-up, or technical coordination of industrial systems.

•       Experience supporting projects through design review, field execution, and commissioning phases.

•       Strong understanding of hydroelectric systems, including automation, instrumentation, control systems, and auxiliary electro-mechanical interfaces.

•       Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, control diagrams, technical drawings, specifications, and commissioning documentation.

•       Knowledge of commissioning methodologies, system validation, and field troubleshooting practices.

•       Experience with applicable industry standards such as IEEE, NEC, NETA, and internal quality procedures.

 

Wage $121,930/year. Email resumes to person@example.com Reference job title in subject line.​
